desc: Ideation: identify odd-N fixed-parity case and even-N component-type reduction.
Implement and run reduced component-type minimax explorer for small N to guide the criterion.
Derive closed-form even-N criterion (u, isolated count, size%4 parity, M parity).
Implement final O(N+M) solution using the derived criterion and make it pass the sample tests.
Validate final solution on random small bipartite graphs against exhaustive brute force and edge cases (N=1, all isolated, all even, u=2, i=u, i=u-2, i<=u-3).
